decisions.choice: Generate exact target ASTs from a fixed relation policy; caller statement lists cannot erase them

decisions.basis: No automatic unification from nominal labels
decisions.choice: Support explicit identity shared-carrier alignments with exact local record bindings; other mapping semantics stay unsupported

decisions.basis: No promotion from a witness to all-model distinction
decisions.choice: Finite control checks return model-local outcomes; universal-property obligations require separate proof evidence

decisions.basis: No vacuous or silently exempt population
decisions.choice: Require a population entry for each relation endpoint; exemptions produce a review obligation and unresolved records retain their existential target

obligation_coverage: All software/design criteria mapped; actual source-owner fidelity remains a separate later obligation.

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: Positive alias, proper subtype and explicit coupling controls pass; false alias, collapsed distinction, empty required population and unaligned carriers remain failed/unresolved.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Specify aliases, subtype inclusion/properness, overlap, disjointness and named forbidden inferences; distinguish non-entailment from all-model distinction; assign required or explicitly exempt population obligations per carrier.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.

validation.reviewable_check: Positive alias, proper subtype and explicit coupling controls pass; false alias, collapsed distinction, empty required population and unaligned carriers remain failed/unresolved.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
